mentions.name: Amigurumis.com.mx online store
mentions.description: Small online store (amigurumis.com.mx) managed for the author's significant other, being migrated off the Elementor page builder to a Gutenberg-only WordPress site, which works well for simple sites.
mentions.problem: Elementor is too expensive for maintaining the store's site.
mentions.source_excerpt: I manage a small store (https://amigurumis.com.mx) for my SO and im dropping Elementor (too expensive) to use only Gutenberg. Turns out that it is pretty good for simple sites.
